    | .inr request => tailAuxFwd codec checks request) ∘ₛ PqxdhServerRegistrationPublication.nativeAdapter

    (StateT (List RawCtxSourceSend.SealContext) (OracleComp (EnvEffects n)))
  | .inl (.inl request) => StateT.lift (nativeTailFwd setup codec checks (.inl (.inl request)))
  | .inl (.inr input) => fun log => do
      let sealed ← nativeTailFwd setup codec checks (.inl (.inr input))
      pure (sealed, if sealed.isSome then log ++ [input.context] else log)
  | .inr query => StateT.lift (nativeTailFwd setup codec checks (.inr query))

definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironment.ownerEffect:
def ownerEffect (index : Nat) (before after : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK) : OracleComp (EnvEffects n) Unit :=
  match before.beacon.phase, after.beacon.phase with
  | .established _ _ _, _ => pure ()
  | _, .established control associatedData kernel =>
      issue (.installBeacon index ⟨after.beacon.identityKeyId, control, associatedData⟩ (.known kernel))
  | previous, current => match inactiveTag current with
      | some tag => if inactiveTag previous = some tag then pure () else issue (.advanceOwner index tag)
      | none => pure ()

  match settled.1 with
  | none => pure ()
  | some response => match settled.2.server.peers response.keyId with
      | none => pure ()
      | some peer => issue (.installServer response.keyId peer.identity (.known peer.kernel))

  match PqxdhDeploymentInterface.parsePin pin with

  | some word => do

    ownerChange owner state.native.owners result.2.owners
    pure (result.1, { state with native := strip result.2 })

noncomputable def acceptStep (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) : StateT (EnvState KemSK Bk) (OracleComp (EnvEffects n)) (Option Nat) :=
  fun state => (fun result => (result.1.1, { state with native := strip result.2, log := state.log ++ [result.1.2] })) <$>
    coins ((PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.onShared
      (PqxdhDeploymentLaterServerNative.acceptLogged setup codec checks state.created.seed raw)).run state.native)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironment.buildStep:
noncomputable def buildStep (session : Nat) (payload : Option Pqxdh.Bytes) :
    StateT (EnvState KemSK Bk) (OracleComp (EnvEffects n)) (Option PqxdhServerRegistrationPublication.Response) :=
  fun state =>
    let game := state.native.shared.2
    match game.pending session with
    | none => pure (none, state)
    | some token => do
        let result ← (simulateQ (tailFwd setup codec checks)
          (PqxdhServerRegistrationPublication.build setup.source token.pending token.root payload () game.server)).run []
        let settled := PqxdhServerAuthExperiment.settle game.server result.1
        serverEffect settled
        let native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK := { state.native with shared := (state.native.shared.1, { game with
          pending := Function.update game.pending session none
          server := settled.2
          ghost := { game.ghost with seals := game.ghost.seals ++ result.2.map (fun context => (session, context)) } }) }
        pure (settled.1, { state with native := strip native })
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironment.finishStep:
noncomputable def finishStep (owner : Nat) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) :
    StateT (EnvState KemSK Bk) (OracleComp (EnvEffects n)) (Option Pqxdh.Bytes) :=
  fun state =>
    match state.native.owners[owner]? with
    | none => pure (none, state)
    | some before => do
        let result ← (simulateQ (callbacksFwd setup codec)
          (PqxdhBeaconPhase2Publication.nativeOwner codec.frameRead raw before)).run state.native.shared
        ownerEffect owner before result.1.2
        let native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK :=
          ⟨result.2, state.native.owners.set owner result.1.2⟩
        pure (result.1.1, { state with native := strip native })

definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironment.realStep:
noncomputable def realStep : EnvStep KemSK Bk n := fun query state =>
  match query with
  | ⟨.create pin keyId, _⟩ => (createStep setup pin keyId).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.bundle owner, _⟩ => (bundleStep setup codec owner).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.accept raw, _⟩ => (acceptStep setup codec checks raw).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.build session payload, _⟩ => (buildStep setup codec checks session payload).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.finish owner raw, _⟩ => (finishStep setup codec owner raw).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.hmac key message, _⟩ => (hmacStep setup key message).run (snapped query state)
  | ⟨.hash _, notEnv⟩ => absurd notEnv id
  | ⟨.serverSend _ _, notEnv⟩ => absurd notEnv id
  | ⟨.serverRaw _, notEnv⟩ => absurd notEnv id
  | ⟨.beaconSend _ _, notEnv⟩ => absurd notEnv id
  | ⟨.beaconRaw _ _, notEnv⟩ => absurd notEnv id

  | kind, .coin => ![0, 64 + caps.keygenCost, 32, 96 + caps.encapsCost, 0, 69 * max 64 caps.decapsCost, 64,
      0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] kind
  | kind, .hash => if kind = 4 ∨ kind = 5 then 1 else 0
  | kind, .administrative => if kind = 1 ∨ kind = 2 ∨ kind = 4 ∨ kind = 5 then 1 else 0

noncomputable def touch (table : LazyOracleDiscard.CacheLens (PqxdhDeploymentSeedSplit.MaterialSpec n) Bk) (slot : Slot n) :

noncomputable def wrapStep (table : LazyOracleDiscard.CacheLens (PqxdhDeploymentSeedSplit.MaterialSpec n) Bk)
    (slotOf : EnvQuery → EnvState KemSK Bk → Option (Slot n))
    (core : (query : EnvQuery) → Option PqxdhDeploymentHiddenLayout.Material →

definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.fillOwner:
def fillOwner (phase : Option PqxdhRecordLiftBeacon.Phase) (owner : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK) :
    PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK :=
  match phase, owner.beacon.phase with
  | some (.established shell kernel), .established _ _ _ => { owner with beacon := { owner.beacon with
      identityKeyId := shell.identityKeyId
      phase := .established shell.control shell.associatedData kernel } }
  | _, _ => owner
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.stripPhas:

definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.Good:
structure Good {Bk : Type} (created : PqxdhLiveServerConstruction.Created Unit) (e : EnvState KemSK Bk)
    (w : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) : Prop where
  stripped : Stripped e.native
  createdEq : e.created = created
  server : ∃ world, w.server = some world ∧ world.sender = e.native.shared.2.server.identityKeyId ∧
    world.records.server.identity = e.native.shared.2.server.server.identity ∧
    ∀ keyId, (world.records.server.peers keyId).map stripPeer = e.native.shared.2.server.server.peers keyId
  ownersLength : w.owners.length = e.native.owners.length
  owners : ∀ (index : Nat) (owner : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK), e.native.owners[index]? = some owner →
    (w.owners[index]?).map stripPhase = some (PqxdhRecordLiftBeacon.projectPhase owner.beacon)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.fixedView:
noncomputable def fixedView (w : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) :
    (Slot n → PqxdhRecordLiftInterface.Role → Bool) × PqxdhRecordLiftLazyTable.State (PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.SeedSpec n) ×
      Option (Std.U64 × RawCtxServerRouting.Identity × (Std.U64 → Option (RawCtxServerRouting.Peer Unit))) ×
      List PqxdhRecordLiftBeacon.Phase :=
  (w.used, w.seeds, w.server.map (fun server => (server.sender, server.records.server.identity,
    fun keyId => (server.records.server.peers keyId).map stripPeer)), w.owners.map stripPhase)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.Stable:
def Stable {Bk : Type} (inv : EnvState KemSK Bk → PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : EnvState KemSK Bk) (w w' : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n), fixedView w' = fixedView w → inv e w → inv e w'
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.worldStep:
noncomputable def worldStep (env : Environment n (EnvState KemSK Bk)) :
    QueryImpl PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Spec (StateT (EnvState KemSK Bk × PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) ProbComp) :=
  ((PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.handler setup codec route).mapStateTBase (PqxdhRecordLiftInterface.native env)).flattenStateT
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.Splits:
def Splits (created : PqxdhLiveServerConstruction.Created Unit) (reg : RegImpl KemSK Bk n) (step : EnvStep KemSK Bk n)
    (inv : EnvState KemSK Bk → PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ (query : EnvQuery) (e : EnvState KemSK Bk) (w : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n), Good created e w → inv e w →
    LawEq ((fun result => (result.1.1, merge result.1.2 result.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.effects ((step query).run e)).run w) ((reg query).run (merge e w)) ∧
      ∀ result ∈ support ((simulateQ PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.effects ((step query).run e)).run w),
        Good created result.1.2 result.2 ∧ inv result.1.2 result.2
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.uncount:
def uncount (w : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n :=
  { w with primitive := (PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.Counts.empty, w.primitive.2) }
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.joined:
def joined {Out : Type} (result : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit ×
    (Out × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.Ledger) × EnvState KemSK Bk) × PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) :
    Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × Out × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.Ledger × XState KemSK Bk n) :=
  result.1.map fun value => (value.1, value.2.1.1, value.2.1.2, merge value.2.2 result.2)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.envReveal:
def envReveal {Bk : Type} (e : EnvState KemSK Bk) : PqxdhDeploymentLaterServerGame.Reveal :=
  (PqxdhDeploymentLater.revealOf e.native.owners e.snap, (some e.created.seed, e.log))
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.postNativ:
noncomputable def postNative (reg : RegImpl KemSK Bk n) :
    QueryImpl PqxdhDeploymentLater.PostSpec (StateT (XState KemSK Bk n) ProbComp) :=
  handlerWith setup codec route reg ∘ₛ PqxdhDeploymentLater.postEmbed
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.toyFresh:
def toyFresh (keyId : Std.U64) (e : EnvState KemSK Bool) : Bool :=
  !e.backend && (e.native.shared.2.server.server.peers keyId).isNone
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.toyStep:
noncomputable def toyStep (slot : Slot n) (keyId : Std.U64) (identity : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity)
    (reply : (query : EnvQuery) → EnvSpec.Range query) : EnvStep KemSK Bool n := fun query e =>
  if toyFresh keyId e then
    (fun _ => (reply query, toyAfter keyId identity e)) <$>
      PqxdhDeploymentEnvironment.request (.installServer keyId identity (.hidden slot))
  else pure (reply query, e)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.lazySeed:
noncomputable def lazySeed (table : (PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.SeedSpec n).QueryCache) (slot : Slot n) :
    ProbComp (PqxdhRecordLiftSeed.Seed × (PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.SeedSpec n).QueryCache) :=
  match table slot with
  | some seed => pure (seed, table)
  | none => (fun seed => (seed, table.cacheQuery slot seed)) <$> ($ᵗ PqxdhRecordLiftSeed.Seed)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.toyInstal:
noncomputable def toyInstalled {KemSK : Type} (keyId : Std.U64) (identity : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity)
    (x : XState KemSK Bool n) (drawn : PqxdhRecordLiftSeed.Seed × (PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.SeedSpec n).QueryCache) :
    XState KemSK Bool n :=
  { x with
    base := { x.base with native := addPeer keyId ⟨identity, PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.kernel .server drawn.1, ()⟩ x.base.native }
    backend := true
    seeds := drawn.2 }
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.toyReg:
noncomputable def toyReg (slot : Slot n) (keyId : Std.U64) (identity : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity)
    (reply : (query : EnvQuery) → EnvSpec.Range query) : RegImpl KemSK Bool n := fun query x =>
  if !x.backend && (x.base.native.shared.2.server.server.peers keyId).isNone then
    (fun drawn => (reply query, toyInstalled keyId identity x drawn)) <$> lazySeed x.seeds slot
  else pure (reply query, x)
definitions.PqxdhDeploymentEnvironmentJoin.toyInv:
def toyInv (slot : Slot n) (e : EnvState KemSK Bool) (w : PqxdhRecordLiftWorld.State n) : Prop :=
  w.used slot .server = e.backend
